integrity: The binary Reynolds equations are reconstructed directly, and the ternary identity is independently replayed. The three-branch decomposition is proved without characteristic assumptions beyond invertibility of the chosen nonzero weight. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies all weights over several finite fields, including characteristic two.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the two-dimensional Lie-Yamaguti algebra in Teng-Guo Example 2.5.
The accepted classification is restricted to nonzero Reynolds weight.
The automorphism quotient is internal to the fixed Lie-Yamaguti algebra.
title: Three-branch nonzero-weight Reynolds moduli in a two-dimensional Lie–Yamaguti algebra
